note: Both sets heavily duplicate the 20% glazing/façade fact and share the same core claims (Nitinol wire actuator, Flexinol = trade name for Nitinol, latent solar energy, no additional energy, rotational louver closure, smart material). Set A binds the facts more cleanly overall, while Set B adds errors: it attributes the 20% to the HARVEST SCREEN rather than the HARVEST HOME's southern façade, restates 20% as an 'operable glazing area', and uses a spliced, non-contiguous quote ('Harvest Shade Screens imbued a more novel, Through the design and development of a Nitinol wire actuator'). Set A's main faults are one equally misbound 'composition percentage of HARVEST SCREEN' claim and a truncated 'of HARVEST' entity, plus redundancy and a couple of vague 'smart material' claims. Neither set invents facts beyond these binding and quoting problems.
